title: Nike
subtitle: CEO Communication Failure
description: CEO publicly admitted the recovery was slow — without a forward-looking narrative. The statement was indexed within minutes. Shares fell 14–15% to a 10-year low in one session.
label: MECHANIC
explanation: Every public statement by a senior executive becomes a permanent part of the digital profile. It surfaces in every future due diligence — years later.

title: Supermicro
subtitle: Regulatory Escalation
description: One internal compliance signal went unmanaged. It was followed by a regulator investigation, auditor resignation, and government contracts placed at risk.
label: MECHANIC
explanation: Preventive work costs a fraction of responding after a regulator intervenes. One unclosed signal started a cascade that lasted months.

title: University system hack
subtitle: Crisis Without Narrative Management
description: CEO issued a public apology. Reuters published it. That article is now permanently indexed — surfacing in every investor and partner due diligence that follows.
label: SOURCE: LEXISNEXIS 2026
explanation: Monitoring negative news is now mandatory in due diligence, not an optional add-on.
